llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only orchestrator that matches its description (a 5‑step grounding pipeline) and does not request extra credentials or install anything, but it assumes the presence of child skills and external search connectors which the package does not declare.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (a 5‑step 'signal intelligence' grounding pipeline) match the SKILL.md: the skill is solely an orchestrator that splits tasks into queries, routes sources, cleans evidence, judges freshness, and hunts counter-evidence. No unrelated binaries, env vars, or installs are required.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions stay within the stated purpose (orchestrating 5 subskills and producing an Enhanced Evidence Base). However, the runtime instructions repeatedly require calling five subskills (query-planner, source-router, evidence-cleaner, freshness-judge, counter-evidence-hunter) and executing searches/raw_fetches; the skill does not include those child skills or specify how to access external search connectors, so correct behavior depends entirely on the agent environment having those capabilities. There is no instruction to read unrelated system files or hidden endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code is provided (instruction-only). This minimizes disk/write risk — nothing is downloaded or installed by the skill package itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials, which is proportionate to an instruction-only orchestrator. Caveat: the included examples and routing mention external sources (e.g., 'tavily', 'bailian', 'web_search') that in some deployments may require API keys or connectors; those are not declared here. Ensure required connectors/credentials (if any) are provided by the agent platform and not implicitly requested by the skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No 'always: true' or elevated privileges requested; the skill is user-invocable and may be invoked autonomously by the agent (platform default). It does not request to modify other skills or system configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an orchestration/instruction bundle (no code) that expects five child subskills and search/connectors to exist in the agent environment. Before enabling it: (1) confirm your agent already has the referenced subskills or connectors (e.g., web_search, tavily, bailian) and understand whether those connectors require API keys; (2) review how external searches are performed in your agent (will queries go to third‑party APIs, internal corpora, or browser-based web fetches?) because the skill will route many queries externally; (3) test with low‑risk informational tasks to verify outputs and source diversity — the routing examples show heavy reliance on a single source (tavily) which can bias results; (4) if you handle sensitive inputs, ensure the agent's search connectors and logs meet your privacy/compliance requirements. Overall the package is coherent with its stated purpose, but its correct and safe operation depends on the runtime environment and connectors that are not included in the skill bundle.
